real_pg.result: 23/23 PASS on the second run — the first run surfaced 4 genuine test-authoring bugs (not implementation defects), each fixed with the measured evidence: (1) two fixture UUIDs used invalid hex digits 'x'/'y'; (2) PG-3-2 demanded the RLS-wall message specifically, but CE-1's migration grants uellix_writer NO table privilege on commercial_accounts at all (measured: db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql grants every OTHER public table per-table, no ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES covers schema public, and CE-1 issues no GRANT) — the ACL wall is equally correct denial evidence, so the assertion was widened to accept either message, with the RLS mechanism itself independently proven by PG-3-0c/0d and the two FORCE/policy mutation controls; (3) CE1-FK-1 expected SQLSTATE 23001 (restrict_violation) but PostgreSQL implements ON DELETE RESTRICT via 23503 (foreign_key_violation) — corrected and renamed; (4) MUT-PG-CE1-2 had a bare SELECT inside a DO block (PL/pgSQL requires PERFORM) and, once fixed, exposed that a hypothetical policy alone cannot leak data without a table GRANT either — the mutation now adds both, modeling the real regression; (5) MUT-PG-CE1-3's CASCADE mutation was blocked by the fixture's own unrelated organization_members FK, unrelated to what the control was proving — fixed by clearing those rows first, inside the same rolled-back transaction.

proves.PG-3: uellix_app (tenant-facing runtime role) denied SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on commercial_accounts (PG-3-1..4); platform super-admin ALSO denied (PG-3-5, Platform Admin access is CE-8's, not CE-1's); role is asserted NOT rolbypassrls and the table's asserted owner is uellix_owner not uellix_app (PG-3-0a/0b); pg_class.relrowsecurity AND relforcerowsecurity both true (PG-3-0c); zero rows in pg_policies for the table (PG-3-0d).
proves.PG-1: an OrgA-scoped subject sees exactly 1 organization and the SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW (OrgB, sharing CommercialAccount X) never appears (PG-1-1); the reverse holds for OrgB (PG-1-2); current_user_org_ids() is not widened by the shared account (PG-1-3).
proves.N-16: SENTINEL_UNGOVERNED_ORG's commercial_account_id reads NULL and grants no extra visibility.
proves.P-3: reassigning commercial_account_id overwrites the scalar, never stacks.
proves.FK/reapply: ON DELETE RESTRICT refuses 23503 naming the CE-1 FK by name; a second CREATE TABLE refuses 42P07 (destructive-on-reapply, as classified).
proves.mutations: FORCE removed -> table owner CAN then read (proving FORCE was load-bearing); a hypothetical GRANT+POLICY pair added -> tenant reads leak (proving PG-3-0d/PG-3-1 would catch a real regression); RESTRICT relaxed to CASCADE -> deleting the account silently drops the organization (proving RESTRICT was load-bearing).
